def test_split_words():
    # Branch 1: contains a space -> split on whitespace

    assert split_words(" ") == []                    # whitespace-only string
    assert split_words("word ") == ["word"]

    # Branch 2: no spaces, contains commas -> commas act as separators
    assert split_words("Hello,world!") == ["Hello", "world!"]
    assert split_words("a,b,c") == ["a", "b", "c"]
    assert split_words(",") == []                    # comma-only string
    assert split_words(",a,") == ["a"]
